parrafos: This Porsche 911 Carrera 4S Coupé of the 997.1 generation combines the wide, muscular image of the 4S with the ease of use of the transmission Tiptronic. Produced in April 2007, presents a sober and coherent configuration: body in black Z4, tires Carrera S of 19 inches, suspension PASM and multimedia system PCM 2.
This is a unit known by Valentin Motors, with a long history of servicing, and has a negative Bore Scoring check, a particularly relevant check on vehicles of this generation.
intro.cita: It is not an inferior version to the manual: it is a 4S aimed at those looking for the presence of the body, the safety of all-wheel drive and comfortable and fluid driving on a daily basis.

fotos.caption: Side profile · Wide fins of the 4S
Cabin · Black leather and Tiptronic selector

parrafos: The atmospheric flat-six 3,8 liters (engine code 9701) delivery 355 hp with the linear response characteristic of the 997.1 generation. The transmission Tiptronic reinforces the versatile character of the Carrera 4S: it allows relaxed and progressive driving, especially in the city, long journeys and everyday use, while retaining the possibility of manually intervening in gear selection.

The all-wheel drive adds mobility and poise without eliminating the rear character of the 911. The PASM system allows you to adapt the response of the suspension and combine comfortable use on the road with firmer behavior when sporty driving is desired. The transmission is part of the mechanical assembly covered by the warranty of 12 on the engine and gearbox.

exterior.texto: The body in black Z4 with the flared fins of the Carrera 4S gives this unit a presence special. Oval headlights typical of the 997, Carrera S wheels of 19 inches, roof without electric opening and four exhaust outlets complete a sober, technical and timeless reading.

interior.editorial: An interior faithful to the original configuration of the 997.1: black leather seats, steering wheel with metal spokes, silver instrument panel rings, PCM system 2 and Tiptronic selector on the center console.

opinion.bio: More than 25 years of experience with collectible Porsche. He has supervised hundreds of sales and purchase operations of special vehicles, with a special focus on 911 of analog generations.
opinion.intro: "A Porsche 997 ready to enjoy, backed by history, inspection and warranty."
parrafos: The Carrera 4S adds to the classic silhouette of the 911 one body wider rear and a particularly recognizable presence. The communication of this unit should not be compared with the manual version as if one were superior to the other: the value of this 4S It is in its ease of use, its known status and its balanced configuration.

The Tiptronic transmission promotes comfortable and fluid driving, especially in the city, long journeys and everyday use, without giving up the possibility of managing the gear ratios manually. Together with the PASM system, the result is a 911 that is usable, stable and with a more marked Gran Turismo character than that of a purely analog configuration.

This unit does not come to Valentin Motors solely for a pre-sale inspection: it is a vehicle known to the specialist, with a long history of servicing, a negative Bore Scoring check and a warranty 12 months on engine and gearbox.
